Professional Service Areas You Can Trust

At All Hours Towing, we pride ourselves on providing professional service areas. Our trained technicians use state-of-the-art equipment to ensure the job is done right the first time.

Whether you're dealing with a breakdown on I-75 near Macon, locked out of your vehicle in Warner Robins, or need urgent assistance anywhere in our service area, our team is ready to help. We understand that vehicle emergencies are stressful, which is why we prioritize fast response times and transparent communication.

All Hours Towing Macon GA proudly serves a broad swath of Middle Georgia from our headquarters at 450 Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd in downtown Macon. Our primary service area includes Macon-Bibb County, Warner Robins and Houston County, Byron and Peach County, plus the surrounding communities that make up the economic heart of central Georgia. We provide 24/7 towing and roadside assistance along all major transportation corridors: I-75 from exits 144 to 185, I-16 from Macon eastward toward Dublin and Savannah, I-475 forming the western bypass of Macon, and state routes including GA-49, GA-96, US-41, GA-247, and GA-74. Our two-location strategy—primary dispatch in Macon and satellite staging in Warner Robins—ensures that no point in our coverage area is more than 25-30 minutes from a truck. From these bases, we serve cities and towns including Milledgeville, Forsyth, Fort Valley, Perry, Gray, and smaller communities like Lizella, Payne City, Centerville, Bonaire, and Kathleen. We also extend service to the South Atlanta suburbs—Conyers, Covington, and Monroe—and can arrange long-distance transport throughout Georgia and to neighboring states. Whatever the location and whatever the situation, our dispatchers at (478) 500-8118 know the roads, know the response times, and know exactly which truck to send. We're not a nationwide call center dispatching random contractors—we're your neighbors with three generations of Middle Georgia towing experience.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What areas do you serve in Middle Georgia?

We serve Macon, Warner Robins, Byron, Milledgeville, Forsyth, Fort Valley, Perry, Gray, and all surrounding communities. Our trucks are staged for fast response throughout the region.

Q: How far will you travel for a tow?

We provide towing throughout Middle Georgia and can arrange long-distance transport throughout Georgia and to neighboring states. Call for specific distance inquiries.

Q: Do you serve the South Atlanta area?

Yes—we extend service to Conyers, Covington, Monroe, and surrounding South Atlanta communities. Our Warner Robins staging area keeps response times low for these areas.
